CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   C. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.

   B. Pollute rivers deliberately

   D. Waste food daily

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)

   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
